tools.description: Use when you need the full public board for one NFL week (regular season weeks 1 to 18). Returns every game, including the published call, note, chip, hours, and roof. tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Use when you need one game's published weather call. Pass team (a code such as BUF or NE) or gameId (such as 2026-w04-ne-buf). Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. A gameId selects that game's week when weekId is omitted. Returns that game plus asOf, stale, and nextUpdate.

tools.name: get_flags
tools.description: Use when you need every game whose published call is FLAG or WATCH, including domes. Optional weekId; omit it for the current week. Returns those games. For an outdoor kick-time checklist before Sunday lock, use get_sunday_lock_sheet.

tools.name: get_sunday_lock_sheet
tools.description: Use before Sunday lock for a kick-time checklist of outdoor weather games that need a look. Prefer this over get_flags when the user wants that checklist. Optional weekId (YYYY-wNN); omit it for the current week. Returns FLAG and WATCH games whose roof is outdoor, or retractable and confirmed open,

tools.name: get_report_card
tools.description: Use when you need a published Sideline report card, the same cards as /report-cards. Optional week (1 to 18) or weekId (YYYY-wNN). Omit both for the newest published card. Returns that card and the season-to-date totals. Grades are historical. For the live weather call, use get_game.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Use when you need games whose published call, roof, window, or kick-window reading moved since a time you give. Pass since (ISO time).
